annotations.title: Accounts worth watching in this niche

description: Up to 10 public handles that at least 3 other organizations in the same primary sub-niche already watch, with a band for how many (3-5, 6-20, 20+) and a reason, plus the sub-niche's starter accounts when it has any. Handles this workspace already watches are left out. Nothing says who watches them. Empty list with a note: set the niche first (niche_set), or too few watch anything yet. Add one with competitor_add. With account_id the niche is that account's primary one (an account with none of its own uses the workspace default); without it, the workspace's primary niche.

account_id.description: The account being viewed. Omit to use the workspace's primary niche

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.
